title: Design and Screening of the Peptide SAMP-12aa Derived from LL-37, Which Exhibits Anti-H. Pylori Activity and Immunomodulatory Effects.
authors: Lu, Jianliang; Wang, Qingyu; Qin, Meisong; Dou, Jinfeng; Xiong, Youyi; Zhang, Xiaolin
one_liner_zh: 该文设计抗菌肽SAMP-12aa并研究其抗幽门螺杆菌及免疫调节作用，虽含分子对接预测肽与Foxp3蛋白结合，但对象为肽-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法核心应用，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The appearance of antibiotic-resistant strains of Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is leading to a decreased eradication rate of H. pylori infection. There is an urgent need to find new agents with antimicrobial mechanisms different from those of antibiotics, with therapeutic potential to clear colonization of H. pylori in the stomach. Some antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) possess bactericidal activity by enhancing the permeability of the outer membrane and damaging the integrity of the cell membrane. Bacteria are not susceptible to drug resistance through this antimicrobial mechanism. In this study, 28 short peptides containing 12 amino acid residues were designed based on nine amino acid fragments (KRIVQRIKD) from human cathelicidin LL-37, which is stable in gastric juice, and 3 amino acids were added at the C-terminus of the peptide. These designed peptides were not digested and degraded by pepsin at low pH values. The peptides were predicted using the online tool platform. Then, the strongest antimicrobial peptide, named SAMP-12aa (KRIVQRIKDVIR), was screened from 28 short peptides. Further studies found that SAMP-12aa retained anti-H. pylori activity after incubation in simulated gastric juice. The MIC and MBC of SAMP-12aa were 8 mug/mL and 32 mug/mL, respectively. SAMP-12aa showed good bactericidal kinetics. SAMP-12aa was found to have cell selectivity, penetrating and damaging bacterial cell membranes and exhibiting almost no toxicity to human cells at a relatively high concentration (128 mug/mL). Regulatory T (Treg) cells express CD25(High) with immunosuppressive activity that induces immune tolerance in response to H. pylori. Molecular docking prediction revealed that SAMP-12aa could target the active center of Foxp3. Flow cytometry analysis revealed that SAMP-12aa can inhibit Foxp3 activity and downregulate CD25 protein expression on CD4(+) T cells, thereby reducing the development and differentiation of CD4(+)Foxp3(+)CD25(High) Treg cells with immunosuppressive effects. Further research revealed that the levels of the cytokine interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma), which activates CD8(+) T-cell activity, were significantly elevated, and the levels of transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta), which inhibits CD8(+) T-cell activity, were significantly reduced. The results of this study reveal that SAMP-12aa not only possesses antibacterial activity but also has immunomodulatory effects.
abstract_zh: 幽门螺杆菌（H. pylori）耐药菌株的出现正导致H. pylori感染根除率下降。迫切需要寻找具有不同于抗生素抗菌机制的新药物，以具备清除胃内H. pylori定植的治疗潜力。一些抗菌肽（AMPs）通过增强外膜通透性和破坏细胞膜完整性来发挥杀菌活性。细菌不易通过这种抗菌机制产生耐药性。本研究基于人导管素LL-37（在胃液中稳定）中的九个氨基酸片段（KRIVQRIKD），设计了28条含12个氨基酸残基的短肽，并在肽的C端添加了3个氨基酸。这些设计肽在低pH值下不被胃蛋白酶消化和降解。使用在线工具平台对肽进行预测。随后，从28条短肽中筛选出抗菌活性最强的肽，命名为SAMP-12aa（KRIVQRIKDVIR）。进一步研究发现，SAMP-12aa在模拟胃液中孵育后仍保持抗H. pylori活性。SAMP-12aa的MIC和MBC分别为8 μg/mL和32 μg/mL。SAMP-12aa表现出良好的杀菌动力学。发现SAMP-12aa具有细胞选择性，能穿透并破坏细菌细胞膜，且在相对较高浓度（128 μg/mL）下对人细胞几乎无毒性。调节性T（Treg）细胞表达CD25(High)，具有免疫抑制活性，诱导对H. pylori的免疫耐受。分子对接预测显示，SAMP-12aa可靶向Foxp3的活性中心。流式细胞术分析显示，SAMP-12aa能抑制Foxp3活性并下调CD4(+) T细胞上的CD25蛋白表达，从而减少具有免疫抑制作用的CD4(+)Foxp3(+)CD25(High) Treg细胞的发育和分化。进一步研究发现，激活CD8(+) T细胞活性的细胞因子干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）水平显著升高，而抑制CD8(+) T细胞活性的转化生长因子-β（TGF-β）水平显著降低。本研究结果表明，SAMP-12aa不仅具有抗菌活性，还具有免疫调节作用。
